BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE SUSMITA PHUKAN KHAUND  ORDER Date : 21-04-2023 1.

Heard Mr. N Uddin, learned counsel for the petitioner, Imran Hussain and Mr. K. K. Das, learned Addl. PP, appearing for the State.
2.

The petitioner has filed an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C., with prayer for bail as he is in custody since 22.03.2023 in connection with Bongaigaon PS Case No.139/2023 under sections 120(B)/420/511 IPC.
Page No.# 2/2 3.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar and have also perused the Case Diary.

sentences.text: The FIR unfolds that on a tip off, the informant along with his police party apprehended the petitioner and seized several ATM cards from the possession of the petitioner.
5. The learned Addl. PP has raised serious objections stating that the petitioner was found in possession of 21 ATM cards.

It can be easily inferred that these ATM cards were illegally used for withdrawal of money from the accounts of the persons from whom these ATM cards were stolen or from the persons whose ATM cards were missing.
6. There are cogent materials in the case diary against the petitioner.
A scrutiny of the Case Diary reveals that indeed there are incriminating materials against the petitioner.
However, investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
7. I have considered the length of detention and progress of investigation.
8. In view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs.30,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of CJM Bongaigaon under the conditions that:
i.
The petitioner will cooperate with the investigation as well as the trial and on his failure to comply with the conditions, bail will be cancelled.
9. In terms of the above, the instant bail application stands disposed of.
10. Send back the Case Diary.
